propositions.name: offspring_is_branch_of_parent
propositions.quote: the offspring is termed a new animal, but is in truth a branch or elongation of the parent
propositions.statement: The offspring is not entirely new but is a branch or elongation of the parent, retaining some habits of the parent-system.

propositions.name: embryon_produced_by_male
propositions.quote: we may conclude, that the embryon is produced by the male, and the proper food and nidus by the female
propositions.statement: The living embryon is produced by the male, while the female contributes only the food and nidus.

propositions.name: buds_exactly_resemble_parent
propositions.quote: This paternal offspring of vegetables, I mean their buds and bulbs, is attended with a very curious circumstance; and that is, that they exactly resemble their parents
propositions.statement: Paternal offspring produced without a mother, as buds and bulbs, exactly resemble their parents.

propositions.name: growth_by_apposition_not_distention
propositions.quote: the fetus or embryon is formed by apposition of new parts, and not by the distention of a primordial nest of germs
propositions.statement: The embryon acquires its parts by accretion of new parts, not by distention of pre-existing miniature parts.

propositions.name: mules_disprove_preformation
propositions.quote: how could mule-animals be produced, which partake of the forms of both the parents, if the original embryon was a miniature existing in the semen of the male parent
propositions.statement: The existence of mules resembling both parents refutes the doctrine that the embryon is a preformed miniature in the male semen.

propositions.name: new_organs_new_appetencies
propositions.quote: With every new change, therefore, of organic form, or addition of organic parts, I suppose a new kind of irritability or of sensibility to be produced
propositions.statement: Every new addition of an organic part to the embryon produces a new kind of irritability, sensibility, and animal appetency.

propositions.name: warm_blooded_common_descent
propositions.quote: all warm-blooded animals have arisen from one living filament, which THE GREAT First Cause endued with animality
propositions.statement: All warm-blooded animals descend from one original living filament endowed by the First Cause with animality.

propositions.name: all_organic_life_one_filament
propositions.quote: one and the same kind of living filaments is and has been the cause of all organic life
propositions.statement: One and the same kind of living filament is and has been the cause of all organic life, animal and vegetable alike.

propositions.name: species_from_mixture_of_orders
propositions.quote: the great variety of species of animals, which now tenant the earth, may have had their origin from the mixture of a few natural orders
propositions.statement: The great variety of species now on earth may have originated from the mixture of a few natural orders.

propositions.name: fertile_mules_founded_species
propositions.quote: those animal and vegetable mules, which could continue their species, have done so, and constitute the numerous families of animals and vegetables which now exist
propositions.statement: Those mules that could continue their species did so, and now constitute the numerous families of animals and vegetables in existence.

propositions.name: sterile_mules_perished
propositions.quote: those mules, which were produced with imperfect organs of generation, perished without reproduction
propositions.statement: Mules produced with imperfect organs of generation perished without reproduction, filtering the surviving forms.

propositions.name: acquired_forms_transmitted
propositions.quote: many of these acquired forms or propensities are transmitted to their posterity
propositions.statement: Many acquired forms or propensities produced by an animal's own exertions are transmitted to its posterity.

propositions.name: perpetual_transformation_by_exertion
propositions.quote: all animals undergo perpetual transformations; which are in part produced by their own exertions in consequence of their desires and aversions
propositions.statement: All animals undergo perpetual transformations produced in part by their own exertions responding to desires and aversions.

propositions.name: three_great_wants_shape_forms
propositions.quote: the three great objects of desire, which have changed the forms of many animals by their exertions to gratify them, are those of lust, hunger, and security
propositions.statement: The three great objects of desire that have changed the forms of many animals through their exertions are lust, hunger, and security.

propositions.name: combat_selects_strongest
propositions.quote: the strongest and most active animal should propagate the species, which should thence become improved
propositions.statement: The final cause of male combat for females is that the strongest and most active animal should propagate the species, which should thence become improved.

propositions.name: adaptations_gradually_produced
propositions.quote: gradually produced during many generations by the perpetual endeavour of the creatures to supply the want of food
propositions.statement: Adaptations for procuring food were gradually produced during many generations by the perpetual endeavour of the creatures to supply their want of food.

propositions.name: domestication_shows_plasticity
propositions.quote: the great changes introduced into various animals by artificial or accidental cultivation, as in horses
propositions.statement: Great changes have been introduced into animals by artificial or accidental cultivation, as in horses and dogs bred for various purposes.

propositions.name: progressive_improvement_ongoing
propositions.quote: the animals, which inhabit it, have constantly improved, and are still in a state of progressive improvement
propositions.statement: The animals inhabiting the earth have constantly improved and remain in a state of progressive improvement.

propositions.name: inheritance_faculty_perpetual
propositions.quote: possessing the faculty of continuing to improve by its own inherent activity, and of delivering down those improvements by generation to its posterity, world without end
propositions.statement: The living filament possesses the faculty of continuing to improve by its own inherent activity and of delivering those improvements down by generation to its posterity indefinitely.

propositions.name: world_generated_not_created
propositions.quote: the world itself might have been generated, rather than created; that is, it might have been gradually produced from very small beginnings
propositions.statement: The world itself might have been generated rather than created, gradually produced from very small beginnings.

propositions.name: state_of_probation_responsibility
propositions.quote: our present situation being a state of probation, which by our exertions we may improve, and are consequently responsible for our actions
propositions.statement: Our present situation is a state of probation which by our exertions we may improve, and for which we are consequently responsible.

propositions.name: male_imagination_marks_sex
propositions.quote: the imagination of the male at the time of copulation, or at the time of the secretion of the semen, may so affect this secretion by irritative or sensitive association
propositions.statement: The imagination of the male at the time of copulation may affect the secretion of the semen so as to produce the similarity of form, features, and sex of the child.

propositions.name: structural_similarity_implies_kinship
propositions.quote: one is led to conclude, that they have alike been produced from a similar living filament
propositions.statement: The great similarity of structure across warm-blooded animals leads to the conclusion that they have alike been produced from a similar living filament.

propositions.name: causes_chain_from_creator
propositions.quote: we may consider the progressive motions of objects as a chain of causes only; whose first link proceeded from the great Creator
propositions.statement: The progressive motions of objects form a chain of causes whose first link proceeded from the great Creator.
